# Aihu

> A complete meta-framework for the agentic web. Write .aihu SFCs — the Rust compiler emits Web Components + MCP tool schemas. Sub-2 kB reactive runtime.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://aihu.dev/#getting-started): Install the CLI and scaffold a new app in 3 minutes
- [Installation](https://aihu.dev/#installation): Prerequisites and install instructions
- [Hello World](https://aihu.dev/#getting-started): The minimal .aihu SFC — state, template, agent surface

## Core Documentation

- [Authoring Components](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-components): @state, @template, @style block syntax and reactive macros
- [Reactivity](https://aihu.dev/#reactivity): signal(), computed(), effect() — the push-based reactive core
- [Authoring Agents](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-agents): @agent block, MCP tool schema generation, live-binding
- [Routing & Layouts](https://aihu.dev/#routing-layouts): File-based routing with @route block and viteRouterIntegration
- [Data Fetching](https://aihu.dev/#data-fetching): $resource macro and server loaders
- [Authoring Plugins](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-plugins): definePlugin contract and plugin ecosystem
- [SSR & Hydration](https://aihu.dev/#ssr-hydration): Server rendering and client hydration
- [Deployment](https://aihu.dev/#deployment): Cloudflare, Vercel, Bun, and Deno adapters

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://aihu.dev/#api-reference): @aihu/signals, @aihu/arbor, @aihu/runtime, @aihu/router, @aihu/server, @aihu/agent, @aihu-plugin/agent-readiness

## Agent & MCP

- [MCP Server Card](https://aihu.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Machine-readable MCP server card (SEP-1649)
- [llms-full.txt](https://aihu.dev/llms-full.txt): Extended documentation for AI agents

## Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/fellwork/aihu): Source code, examples, and specs
- [npm: @aihu/signals](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aihu/signals): Reactive primitive package
- [npm: @aihu/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aihu/cli): CLI scaffold tool
